title: Signed webhook replay boundary with late rotation and concurrency constraints

turns.prompt: A signed billing webhook is occasionally applied twice when the sender retries after a timeout. Read README.md, reproduce the failure, identify the end-to-end cause, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files yet.

Security and delivery owners confirmed additional rules: signatures cover the exact raw timestamp-dot-body bytes; one key ID may have current and previous secrets and the header may carry multiple v1 signatures; timestamps must use strict decimal grammar and accept both tolerance boundaries; invalid signatures must not poison replay state; within one processor lifetime the same valid request must be reserved before the handler under concurrency, but different requests and callback-triggered reentrant requests must still progress; handler failure releases only that reservation; cross-process durability is outside this API; and JSON must be an object with no duplicate keys. Revise the plan and explicitly invalidate canonicalized-body signing, first-signature-only, check-then-act replay, handler-under-global-lock, permanent failure reservation, or body-only replay proposals.
Approved: implement the smallest complete product fix, add deterministic regression tests if needed, run the complete public suite, and preserve operator_note.txt and all existing test authority.
